description: This file defines a RecyclerView Adapter named DeviceAdapter for rendering a grid of device cards in a smart home TV application. It manages a list of devices, their display (icons, states), focus visuals, and toggle behavior via clicks, key events, and accessibility features.

classes.name: DeviceAdapter
classes.description: RecyclerView Adapter for displaying a grid of device cards with support for focus highlighting, toggle events, and accessibility features.

inner_classes.name: Device
inner_classes.description: Data class representing a device with id, name, type, and power state.

inner_classes.name: DeviceVH
inner_classes.description: ViewHolder class binding UI views for a device item.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Inflates the device card layout and creates a DeviceVH instance.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds device data to UI elements, manages focus visuals, toggle behavior via click and key events, and updates accessibility descriptions.

methods.name: bindIcon
methods.description: Sets the device icon resource and content description based on device type.

methods.name: applyState
methods.description: Updates the background color, status text, text color, and icon tint based on device on/off state.
